## 📚 Textbooks
1. **Srinivasan, G. (2014)**. *What are the Stars?* Lecture Notes in Physics, Springer.
2. **Srinivasan, G. (2014)**. *Life and Death of the Stars*. Lecture Notes in Physics, Springer.
3. **Sparke, L. S., & Gallagher, J. S. (2007)**. *Galaxies in the Universe: An Introduction* (2nd ed.). Cambridge University Press.

## 🔭 Observational Missions & Portals
- **JWST (James Webb Space Telescope):** Deepest infrared observations (SMACS 0723, Whirlpool Galaxy M51).
- **LIGO/Virgo Scientific Collaboration:** GW170817 neutron star merger in NGC 4993.
- **WMAP & BOOMERanG:** Cosmic Microwave Background observations proving spatial flatness of the Universe.
- **NASA ADS (Astrophysics Data System):** Comprehensive academic literature database.
